episodes.title: The Immigrant
episodes.summary: Desperate to get an agent inside Syria, Mossad recruits Egyptian-born Eli and puts him through a crash course in spycraft.

episodes.title: What's New, Buenos Aires?
episodes.summary: Solidifying his cover identity in Buenos Aires, Eli makes a serendipitous connection. But his fervor puts the entire mission in jeopardy.

episodes.title: Alone in Damascus
episodes.summary: Eli makes an influential ally. Though early operations in Damascus quickly bear fruit, Dan fears Eli's bold methods will get him killed.

episodes.title: The Odd Couples
episodes.summary: Eli's mission takes a dangerous turn as he tries to report on a secret military installation. Back home, Nadia struggles to raise the children alone.

episodes.title: Fish Gotta Swim
episodes.summary: After a bloody coup, Eli insinuates himself closer to the center of Syrian power. But the emotional demands of the job take a severe toll.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.summary: While Israel prepares to strike a Syrian target identified by Eli, suspicion closes in around him. Retaliation is swift -- and ruthless.
